rh_eating_the_pillars.turn_in_text:
The pillars have stopped ringing hollow.

That's the first good news I've had about the roof since the ground shook three years ago.

rh_the_warden.turn_in_text:
That means my scouts can get further in now.

This is from the gate stores.

rh_under_the_cell.turn_in_text:
Then the hive has nobody left to lead it.

The digging stopped this morning. I had Rurik sit by the wall all night to be sure. Take what Aldis has put aside for you.
